title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Holy Cross campus, from the historic reading rooms of Dinand Library to the modern collaborative spaces in the Prior Performing Arts Center.

cards.title: Dinand Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Historic Library Core
cards.notes: Work in a structured, quiet environment with high ceilings and large windows. Ideal for deep concentration and individual focus during peak academic hours.
cards.short_summary: The central, historic reading room of Dinand Library known for its quiet, scholarly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The main reading room provides a quiet study space essential for developing solid study habits and time management skills.
cards.source_title: Why Studying in the Main Reading Room is Good for the Soul - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Open to students; specific hours vary by semester. Last two hours of operation are restricted to Holy Cross ID holders.

cards.title: Rehm Library
cards.subtitle: Smith Hall
cards.notes: Find a seat in this bright, airy space within Smith Hall. It serves as a quiet venue for study and reflection between lectures and campus forums.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled library and lecture venue located in Smith Hall, used for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in Smith Hall, it also provides quiet space for study and reflection, enhanced library resources on religion and spirituality.
cards.source_title: Rehm Library | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours; often used for scheduled events which may limit study availability.

cards.title: The Beehive Atrium
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Utilize flexible work areas in this three-story architectural atrium. It is designed for gathering, studying, and collaborative arts-based projects.
cards.short_summary: A central, multi-level hub for study and collaboration within the Prior Performing Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The heart of the building, 'The Beehive' is a playground for study and performance, encouraging collaboration via flexible work spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; includes the O'Connor Family Cafe for snacks while studying.

cards.title: O'Callahan Science Library
cards.subtitle: Swords Hall
cards.notes: Study in spacious cubicles or reserve private rooms with whiteboards. This STEM-focused library occupies the first floor of Swords Hall.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated science library offering quiet cubicles and group study rooms with whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: The Science Library occupies the entire first floor of Swords Hall, the central portion of the five-building Integrated Science Complex.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Standard library hours apply; group study rooms can be reserved by students.

cards.title: Fenwick Music Library
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Hall
cards.notes: Access a quiet, sun-drenched space in the east end of Fenwick Hall. It features study tables and playback equipment for music-related research.
cards.short_summary: A specialized music library in Fenwick Hall known for its quiet atmosphere and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: Founded in 1978 and located in the east end of Fenwick Hall, the Music Library collection supports the music department curriculum.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Designated as a strict quiet zone; no cell phone use permitted within the library space.

cards.title: O'Kane Hallway Seating
cards.subtitle: O'Kane Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Use the seating options outside the Enrollment Welcome Center for quick breaks or focused study sessions in a high-traffic campus corridor.
cards.short_summary: Modern seating areas in the O'Kane Hall corridor designed for student study and breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Seating options that span the O'Kane 1 hallway outside the Enrollment Welcome Center provide a space for current students to hunker down for a study session.
cards.source_title: Holy Cross Opens Its New Front Door
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; located in a public hallway near the campus tour starting point.

cards.title: Dinand Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library Basement
cards.notes: Reserve a private room for up to two hours for collaborative projects. These rooms are located on the basement level and allow cell phone use.
cards.short_summary: Reservable private rooms in Dinand Library intended for group work and discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Use this form to reserve a study room in Dinand Library. Each reservation has a two hour maximum.
cards.access_notes: Reservations can be made seven days in advance; Holy Cross ID required for booking.

cards.title: Hogan Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center
cards.notes: Study in a more social atmosphere near Cool Beans or Crossroads. The center offers various lounge areas and flexible seating for casual work.
cards.short_summary: Social study and lounge spaces located within the main campus activity hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of the campus center houses a game room, lounge area, grill and pub.
cards.source_title: Hogan Campus Center | Welcome to the College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open late; typically more noise than library spaces due to dining and student activities.

cards.title: O'Neil Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Integrated Science Complex
cards.notes: Utilize the whiteboard for problem-solving in this dedicated student lounge. It provides a convenient spot for STEM students between labs.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge in O'Neil Hall equipped with whiteboards for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: I spend most of my time either there or in O'Neil, which has a student lounge with a whiteboard.
cards.source_title: A Comprehensive Guide to the Science Complex - The Spire
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students within the science complex during building hours.

cards.title: The Stacks
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library
cards.notes: Find a private cubicle among the book collections for maximum quiet. This area is ideal for individual work requiring minimal distractions.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, individual study cubicles located within the book stacks of Dinand Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The stacks are great, because they are one of the quietest locations on campus and are very conducive to work.
cards.source_title: The 5 Best Study Spots at Holy Cross - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Cell phone reception may be limited in lower levels; open during standard library hours.
